description: Source code for managing a stack of reference tables, including functions for file handling, reloading, compacting, and cleaning reference tables within a version control system.

methods.name: stack_filename
methods.description: Constructs a filename path for a reference table within the stack directory.

methods.name: stack_fsync
methods.description: Performs a file sync operation based on provided options.

methods.name: reftable_write_data
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor, handling partial writes and errors.

methods.name: fd_writer_write
methods.description: Wrapper for writing data using fd_writer.

methods.name: fd_writer_flush
methods.description: Flushes the fd_writer by performing a fsync.

methods.name: fd_read_lines
methods.description: Reads lines from a file descriptor into a string buffer.

methods.name: read_lines
methods.description: Reads lines from a file given by filename.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_ref_iterator
methods.description: Initializes a reference iterator for the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_log_iterator
methods.description: Initializes a log iterator for the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_merged_table
methods.description: Returns the merged table associated with the stack.

methods.name: has_name
methods.description: Checks if a name exists in a list of names.

methods.name: reftable_stack_destroy
methods.description: Destroys and frees resources associated with a stack.

methods.name: stack_copy_tables
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current tables in the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_reload_once
methods.description: Reloads the stack once, optionally reusing open tables.

methods.name: tv_cmp
methods.description: Compares two timeval structures.

methods.name: reftable_stack_reload_maybe_reuse
methods.description: Reloads the stack, reusing open tables if possible.

methods.name: reftable_new_stack
methods.description: Creates a new reference table stack.

methods.name: stack_uptodate
methods.description: Checks if the stack is up-to-date with the filesystem.

methods.name: reftable_stack_reload
methods.description: Reloads the stack if it is out-of-date.

methods.name: reftable_addition_close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up an addition object.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_addition
methods.description: Initializes a new addition to the stack.

methods.name: stack_try_add
methods.description: Attempts to add a new table to the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_add
methods.description: Adds a new table to the stack, reloading if necessary.

methods.name: format_name
methods.description: Formats a name string with update indices and randomness.

methods.name: reftable_addition_destroy
methods.description: Destroys an addition object.

methods.name: reftable_addition_commit
methods.description: Commits an addition, writing new tables and updating the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_new_addition
methods.description: Creates a new addition object for the stack.

methods.name: reftable_addition_add
methods.description: Adds a new table to an ongoing addition.

methods.name: reftable_stack_next_update_index
methods.description: Calculates the next update index for the stack.

methods.name: stack_write_compact
methods.description: Writes a compacted version of a range of tables.

methods.name: stack_compact_locked
methods.description: Performs a locked compaction of a range of tables.

methods.name: stack_compact_range
methods.description: Compacts a range of tables into a single table.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compact_all
methods.description: Compacts all tables in the stack.

methods.name: segment_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of a segment.

methods.name: suggest_compaction_segment
methods.description: Suggests a segment of tables for compaction based on sizes.

methods.name: stack_segments_for_compaction
methods.description: Determines segment for auto or manual compaction.

methods.name: update_segment_if_compaction_required
methods.description: Checks if a segment requires compaction.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compaction_required
methods.description: Checks if stack needs compaction based on heuristics.

methods.name: reftable_stack_auto_compact
methods.description: Performs automatic compaction of the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compaction_stats
methods.description: Returns statistics about stack compaction.

methods.name: reftable_stack_read_ref
methods.description: Reads a reference record from the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_read_log
methods.description: Reads a log record from the stack.

methods.name: is_table_name
methods.description: Checks if a filename corresponds to a table name.

methods.name: remove_maybe_stale_table
methods.description: Removes a stale table if its max update index is below a threshold.

methods.name: reftable_stack_clean_locked
methods.description: Cleans up stale tables in the stack directory.

methods.name: reftable_stack_clean
methods.description: Cleans the stack directory of stale tables.

methods.name: reftable_stack_hash_id
methods.description: Returns the hash ID of the stack's merged table.
